champion_change_playbook.content: Champion Change Playbook v3: (1) Confirm departure via two signals before flagging (LinkedIn title change + stalled activity). (2) Manager review required before any CRM contact status is changed to 'Inactive' or 'Left Company'. (3) Team alerts and follow-up tasks are sent only after the deal owner and manager sign off, to avoid false-alarm churn.

tools.name: query_active_deal_opportunities
tools.description: List the active Q2 opportunities (Stage 3+) with amount, stage, close date, and owner from the Active Deals view.

tools.name: retrieve_champion_contacts
tools.description: Retrieve the primary champion contact record (name, title, contact ID, last activity) for a given opportunity from Salesforce.

tools.name: lookup_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Look up the cached current LinkedIn profile snapshot for a champion to compare title and company against the CRM record.

tools.name: analyze_champion_departure_signals
tools.description: Combine LinkedIn title/company changes with CRM activity history to score whether each champion has likely left their company or changed roles.

tools.name: draft_champion_health_review
tools.description: Compile the at-risk deals, the supporting departure signals, and the suggested CRM record updates and team alerts into a review document for the user's approval.

tools.name: update_salesforce_contact_record
tools.description: Update a Salesforce contact record, e.g. setting a champion's status to 'Left Company' or changing their title/company fields.

tools.name: create_salesforce_followup_task
tools.description: Create a Salesforce follow-up task assigned to the deal owner to act on a detected champion change.

tools.name: post_slack_channel_alert
tools.description: Post an alert to the #deal-risk-alerts Slack channel notifying the team that a champion has changed or left.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their members for reference.

tools.name: read_champion_change_playbook
tools.description: Read the team's champion change playbook describing required confirmation signals and the manager sign-off process.

tools.name: lookup_deal_team_directory
tools.description: Look up the sales team directory, deal owners, and the relevant Slack channels for reference.
